sources.entry: Alternative frontends/portals to discover/filter awesome-selfhosted apps: awweso.me, awesome-web.theravenhub

summary.name: Awesome Selfhosted Browse
summary.one_liner: A browsable, filterable front-end for discovering selfhosted applications listed in the awesome-selfhosted project.
use_cases: Discovering self-hosted apps to run on a home server
Filtering selfhosted software by category, platform or license
Comparing projects by star count or last update
Finding alternatives to commercial SaaS tools
summary.what_it_does: ["Lists 1358 selfhosted applications that can be browsed by category, platform, license, star count and last updated date.", "Shows short descriptions for each listed app, such as a realtime kanban board, a DNS server that blocks ads and trackers, a no-code automation tool, and an enterprise content management system.", "Is one of the alternative frontends linked from the awesome-selfhosted project's External Links section."]
notable: Filters by category, platform, license, star count and last updated
Mirrors the awesome-selfhosted list as a browsable catalog
caveats: Page text is a listing only; it does not state whether the site itself is open source or its pricing terms.
Relies on the underlying awesome-selfhosted data for app information.
